parameters: \c[1]The Sea Shepherd, far out at sea from Port Jenos\c[0]
Alright, here we are, on the edge of a bleedin' storm in the middle of the Herald Sea.\! Well, there's the storm, then there's the bloodthirsty outlaws...
Can we catch up to the Tidereaver ships?
They ain't movin'.\! Probably hunkered down to ride out the storm.\! Wait a minute... you're...
If we don't make an example of them now, we're going to keep getting pushed around.
We can also free the prisoners and treasure they plundered from Port Jenos.
We trust you, \n[8].\! I will fight the cult and their pawns no matter where.
Hell's bells, \n[8]...\| I hope I don't find m'self on yer bad side someday.
